instruction: I want to receive notification banners on my Ubuntu desktop. Please enable notification banners for me.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling notification banners (opposite of original Do Not Disturb mode). Setup disables show-banners (false), agent must enable it (true). Uses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric. Verified: gsettings returns 'true\n' when enabled.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts notification banner state using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.notifications show-banners'
Metric uses exact_match to verify output is exactly 'true\n' (correct format with newline)
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling notification banners, evaluator verifies the setting is enabled
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches gsettings output format when banners are enabled
No postconfig needed: gsettings value persists after agent modifies it
Logic flow is sound: setup disables (false) -> agent enables (true) -> evaluator verifies (true)
